priority_items.title: Vanuatu weighs vessel-category marine warnings after Matui (PMMM-4 floor)
priority_items.summary: In-window Daily Post 21:00 UTC: Climate Change/VMHS/NDMO Minister Regenvanu, speaking at PMMM-4 in Tonga, said Vanuatu is considering linking marine weather warnings to vessel categories following the MV Matui disaster, and asked PMC/SPC to help meet SOLAS V/5. Political intent, not gazetted. Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: Ati to deliver Vanuatu UNGA statement after Napat cancel; Napat to Luganville
priority_items.summary: Catch-up residual Daily Post published_time 20:45 UTC (missed last hourly): Foreign Minister Marc Ati leaves Friday local to deliver Vanuatu’s UNGA-81 statement, return 3 Oct. First Ati UNGA representation following Napat’s Matui-driven cancel. Napat expected in Luganville this morning. Travel notice, not a treaty. Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: China VT5m Ambae drilling machine via Tokatara chiefs (implementation colour)
priority_items.summary: Catch-up residual Daily Post 20:45 UTC: China purchased a VT5 million water-well drilling machine after a Tokatara Council of Chiefs letter on West Ambae volcanic-ash water contamination. ASSESS: in-kind slice of leftover 15 Sep VT11m/US$100k dual-disaster grant unless a second envelope is stated. Not a security pact. Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: NBC recovers; 16 Sep Panguna ceremony now readable (not a licence)
priority_items.summary: NBC homepage HTTP 200 (was 500). First desk-readable copy of Wednesday 16 Sep Panguna gathering: PLIC/chiefs from Guava, Dapera, Moroni, Pirurari apologised to ABG and LPMEL; Guava Chief Titus Miri pledged full support; Tokome cited millions of kina lost. Witnesses include Veterans Minister Dake Jr, Ioro MP Miringtoro, BPS Tokura. Not a mining licence. Not FLASH.
